text:
partners-eng: Heads-up — HaloCompute asked for a focused joint perf/W + throughput scaling run next week. Scope: kernel tuning, power-curve across model scale (13B -> 70B), and marketplace-ready reproducibility. Need owners for experiment matrix, telemetry, and runbook. Volunteers?

sasha: I can own the experiment matrix and pick the model variants. Can we reuse the Ampere configs as a starting point?

partners-eng: Yes, reuse is fine but we need extra power telemetry hooks. Halo will provide PDUs and per-board sensors; we need a collector (telegraf/ipmi) on our side. Also they want kernel-level patch diffs and a peri-run perf/W chart.

james: Quick ask — who owns cloud marketplace packaging and copy? Also we should confirm NDA status before sharing infra access.

rita: I'll contact legal today for NDA. Marketing would like to slot a co-announcement ~2 weeks after results are finalized. Also +1 for a canary run first to validate the harness.

partners-eng: Proposed schedule:
- Mon 09/21: canary run (rw-13b) to validate harness and telemetry.
- Tue-Fri: full sweep across 13B and 70B, quant modes q4_0/q8_0, kernel patch variants, and seq lengths 8k/32k.
Deliverables: perf tables, perf/W curves, kernel diffs, reproducible scripts, and a short runbook for marketplace packaging. Example run command to standardize: 
```
./run_bench --model rw-13b --seq 8192 --batch 1 --quant q8_0 --runtime v2.4.1 --out perf_13b_q8.json
```
(please pin runtime to v2.4.1 for this sprint)

aaron: Quick technical Q: when you say perf/W, are we targeting peak throughput per watt or sustained throughput under a power cap? This changes the telemetry windows we need.

partners-eng: Halo asked for both. Capture a 30s sustained window under the target power cap (95th percentile) and also peak short-run throughput. We should also capture KV-cache hit rates and memory-bandwidth numbers.

sasha: I'll add KV cache flags and prefix-caching scenarios to the matrix. Also will include SDK/runtime pin in the matrix metadata. I'll create the matrix as a CSV with columns: model, seq_len, quant, kernel_tag, batch, runtime, telemetry_flags.

rita: Legal replied — NDA amendment in progress, expect signed copy within 24h. Marketing: penciled co-announcement two weeks after final signoff, wants embargo window noted.

james: Can we get Halo's kernel engineer on a tuning call? Wed morning would be ideal so we can iterate before the full sweep.

partners-eng: Confirmed — kernel lead on call Wed 10:00 PT. Calendar invite incoming. Action items: sasha (matrix + baseline scripts), aaron (telemetry + collector setup), rita (legal & marketing coordination), james (automation harness + CI job). Posting @here for more volunteers :eyes: :rocket: 

sasha: I'll spin up a repo and add a baseline readme + reproducible command list. Will also commit a tiny sample of baseline numbers after the canary.

partners-eng: Thanks team. I'll also ask Halo for their preferred CSV schema for power telemetry so we can map fields. If anyone wants to pair on the canary Monday morning, ping me and I'll add to the invite.

james: pinged infra to reserve the test cluster for Mon-Fri. noted.

rita: copying product to keep track of marketplace requirements.

partners-eng: Folder plan: repo 'bench/halo-scaling-2026', runbook at docs/README.md, raw logs in s3://redwood-bench/halo-scaling-2026/raw. We'll keep kernels/patches in kernel-diffs/.

sasha: starting matrix now, will share draft by EOD.

partners-eng: Perfect — will update thread when NDA lands and when invite is sent.
